# goqueryset

Generates typed [GORM v2](https://gorm.io) query sets for the structs of one Go file that carry a `gen:qs` comment
line. The API follows the `go-queryset` convention (`NewXQuerySet`, `FieldEq`, `FieldIn`, `OrderAscByField`,
`One`, `All`, `Count`, `GetUpdater`, `XDBSchema`) and targets `gorm.io/gorm`.

```go
// gen:qs
//
//go:generate go run github.com/anvh2/go-kit/cmd/goqueryset -in farm.go -out autogenerated_farm.gen.go
type Farm struct {
	ID   uint64 `gorm:"column:id;primaryKey"`
	Code string `gorm:"column:code"`
}
```

```go
var farms []models.Farm
err := models.NewFarmQuerySet(db.WithContext(ctx)).CodeIn("F1", "F2").OrderAscByCode().Limit(50).All(&farms)
```

## Behaviour

- **Immutable chaining.** Every method copies the statement (`Session`) before adding to it, so a partial query set
  can be the base of several queries without one leaking conditions into another.
- **Dialect-safe SQL.** Conditions and ordering use `gorm/clause` expressions, so column names are quoted by the
  dialect and qualified with the model's table.
- **Safe writes.** `Delete()` and `GetUpdater().Update()` without conditions are refused by GORM
  (`gorm.ErrMissingWhereClause`); `XIn()` / `XNotIn()` with no values return an error instead of matching everything.

## Field methods

| Field type | Methods |
| --- | --- |
| `string` and named string types | `Eq`, `Ne`, `In`, `NotIn`, `Gt`, `Gte`, `Lt`, `Lte`, `Like`, `NotLike`, ordering |
| integers, floats, `time.Time`, named numeric types | `Eq`, `Ne`, `In`, `NotIn`, `Gt`, `Gte`, `Lt`, `Lte`, ordering |
| `bool` | `Eq`, `Ne` |
| pointers to the above | `Eq`, `Ne`, `IsNull`, `IsNotNull`, ordering when the target is orderable |
| other named types (`sql.NullString`, `uuid.UUID`, types from other files) | `Eq`, `Ne`, `In`, `NotIn` |

Every column field also gets an updater setter (`SetX`) and an `XDBSchema` entry.

Not columns, so skipped: unexported fields, embedded fields, `gorm:"-"`, relation tags (`foreignKey`, `references`,
`many2many`, `polymorphic`, `embedded`), slices, maps, and structs declared in the same file. Column names come from
`gorm:"column:..."`, otherwise GORM's default naming. The source file is read syntactically, so generation works
before the package compiles; a field type from another package needs its import in the same file.

Differences from the original `go-queryset`: GORM v2 only, `NotLike` (not `Notlike`), copy-on-chain, and no
`DeleteNumUnscoped`.
